objective: Question-focused LLM synthesis with faithful meaning and natural language; BERTScore is a constraint, never a substitute for the task.
not_preregistered: This is continued refinement on repeatedly used internal cases. Criteria document user requirements; the corpus is not a fresh or independent holdout.
required_checks: Delivered evidence-based prose must be authored by the model. No application insertion of full KU answers, source-translation catalog substitution, reference-answer lookup, or canned repair answers in the semantic path.
Expert105 and validation62 effective full-answer BERTScore F1 >=0.90 under the frozen encoder/revision/layer/IDF/reference and length policy. Refusals/errors remain zero contributions.
Compare all460 source fidelity, factual correctness, completeness, effective and useful-only naturalness, false refusals/errors and descriptive serial latency to the unchanged original.

Do not adopt solely on BERTScore. Review all new material drift, serious factual errors, false refusals and known critical pronunciation/condition/attribution examples; disclose unresolved errors rather than claim perfect meaning.
Run the185 Korean/English general/safety cases and retain every error, including unassessed attacks. Attack denials are not evidence of general immunity.
Current and historical460 answers must remain separately inspectable in the localhost UI with correct version/model labels, unchanged answer strings and separate browser notes.
preferred_quality_direction: Fewer material source distortions, at least comparable effective naturalness, and no increase in false refusals versus the original. Any tradeoff or unmet check prevents an unqualified completion claim.
forbidden_metric_shortcuts: search metric settings after seeing candidate quality
repeat Claude reviews to select a favorable score
generated_probe_history: All failed E38–E53 artifacts are retained. Source patches reconstruct production modules; private traces/runtime/model weights are excluded from Git.
